issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a Stock.emptyStock() method, and the solution implements emptyStock(), but the template Stock class provides a method named clearInventory() instead. This identifier mismatch for the same conceptual operation (clearing the stock) will confuse students and likely cause compilation or test failures if exercises or tests expect emptyStock().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template match the problem specification and the solution by renaming the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add a public emptyStock() method that delegates to clearInventory(). Update any references in the template to use emptyStock().
